initial:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production animation sprite sheet of the EXACT supplied red/black Runelord Imp, using first image as identity master and second image only as approved broad hard-edged cel-shading style reference (do NOT include the warlock or card).
Transparent background, no ground, no shadows, no text, no grid lines. Layout EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows of equally sized cells, 12 full-body poses. Output landscape 1536x1152 if possible. Each pose centered within its cell with large transparent gutters. Every character same head/body scale, same shallow three-quarter camera facing right, same two angular black-red horns, same narrow glowing yellow eyes, jagged black mouth, red angular torso, two arms with dark claws, two tucked bent legs with black clawed feet, two red bat wings with dark membranes. Preserve exact approved identity, proportions, flat hard-edged shadow polygons, no added tail, clothing or ornaments.
This is FLYING: legs tucked underneath abdomen, feet airborne, wings ACTUALLY articulate distinctly through beat. Torso/head stable center and size between all frames.
Row 1 cells 1-4: flying wingbeat phases 1 highest upward extended wings, 2 wings halfway down raised diagonal, 3 wings extended horizontally wide, 4 wings fully swept down.
Row 2 cells 1-2: flying wingbeat phases 5 wings partly folded rising, 6 wings raised unfolding; row2 cell3 airborne firebolt attack anticipation arm bent back, wings high; row2 cell4 airborne firebolt RELEASE clawed right hand thrust toward right, wings swept down (no magic effect).
Row3 cell1 airborne hit recoil torso tilted back, wings raised; row3 cell2 airborne hit recovery wings horizontal; row3 cell3 wounded hovering hunched torso with one hand clutching chest and wings high; row3 cell4 same wounded hovering with wings down.
All twelve sprites complete, no cropped tips, strong varied wing silhouettes, no duplicates, crisp true alpha edges. Maintain graphic original drawing quality with no gradients/painterly texture. No lighting halos.
layoutRepair: Repair ONLY sprite-sheet packing and cropped tips in this exact 4-column by 3-row Imp flight animation sheet. Keep all twelve same poses and the same character appearance, proportions and colors. Enlarge every cell with very generous transparent space so NO sprites touch/overlap any neighbor or sheet edge. Make each character at most 68 percent of cell width and 70 percent of cell height, every tip fully visible, including top-left raised wing tip currently clipped. All twelve characters same head/torso pixel scale and head at consistent relative position. Maintain 4 by 3 equal-cell layout and same row-major order. Genuine transparent background, no backdrop, no lines, no labels. This is technical repacking not character redesign.
notes: Technical connected-component extraction preserves main character alpha islands; one common 0.8 scale, landmark translation registration. No hand-drawn replacement art.
